name: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (S&P)
description: Since 1980, the premier forum for computer security and electronic privacy research. The 2026 symposium marks the 47th annual meeting. Published in IEEE Xplore.

peerReview.processDescription: Double-blind peer review with program committee of ~40-50 experts. Papers undergo multiple rounds of review. Mandatory ethics review for all submissions.

attribution.attributionNotes: Published in IEEE Xplore (indexed, citable). Test of Time Awards. Speaker certificates. CPE credits.

povsAlignment.description: Top-tier academic conference with double-blind peer review and indexed proceedings.
